summary: Public mobile preview, demo login, four-tab navigation, class analytics, audit view, scoring format totals, and heavy-item validation were tested.
action_items: Investigate the React Native DevTools root/electron sandbox warning in supervisor logs if development tooling is required; it did not block the preview.
critical_code_review_comments: Current source uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL naming, but the deployed environment and public flow are currently working with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created by this run; existing demo data included one prior TEST-001 respondent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile preview at the supplied public URL loaded successfully. Demo dashboard showed 5 respondents, 2 classes, 25 total problems, and 6 heavy problems. Data -> VII A opened Analitik; Audit displayed deterministic formula and non-diagnostic safeguards.
rca_of_issue: No functional issue reproduced. Backend /api/health, /api/formats, /api/dashboard, /api/schools, /api/scoring/individual and /api/scoring/group paths responded successfully. All five format domain counts summed to their declared totals (75/155/200/210/265); invalid heavy selection returned 400 with the expected subset message. Expo logs contain a non-blocking DevTools electron sandbox warning and an old dashboard render stack trace, but the current public deployment rendered the dashboard normally. MOCKED APIs: none.
